  -- Thought: The information from DuckDuckGo needed verification to confirm the correct carrier.

The VMF-213 Marine Fighting Squadron was assigned to the USS Essex (CV-9) as part of Air Group 4 during World War II. This assignment occurred on December 28, 1944, making them one of the first Marine squadrons to augment a carrier air group. The Essex was a significant carrier in the Pacific, supporting operations in key battles like Iwo Jima and Okinawa.

**Answer:**  
VMF-213 was assigned to the USS Essex (CV-9) as part of Air Group 4, effective December 28, 1944.
